shots.caption: The statistics: submissions checked, accepted and caught over the period, with the share of each check.
Where the spam comes from: countries, networks and systems, with the flags and logos of Gecka Geolocation.
The refused submissions, to review, learn from or delete.
The dashboard widget: the last seven days at a glance.
The Antispam column of the comments, with the spam rating of each one.
The statistical filter: what it learnt, when it rotates, and the comments and messages of the site it can still learn from.
The background tables: the word frequencies of each language of the site, downloaded and kept up to date.
The thresholds of the filter: refused, marked as spam, flagged for review, the texts it needs before it rates anything, and the rotation period.
The forms protected: WordPress, WooCommerce, Contact Form 7, Gravity Forms and ACF, every form or only those holding the marker.
The checks for bots: honeypot, timing, random names and texts, browsers that are none.
How long the statistics are kept.
